messages.subject: About "gpcmIRT"
parts:
Hi phil

Using mirt I realize that there is a function called "gpcmIRT" that differs from "gpcm" and if there is any evidence of being better "graded" proposed by Samejima. I have a one-dimensional test with five items and five likert response alternatives. Performing a comparative analysis I observe that the gpcmIRT has a better fit in my data than the "graded" one. The question is when is it convenient to use "gpcmIRT"?

Best regards
Jose Ventura-Leon
